description: Angular component for widget settings related to navigation cards, including form handling, filtering, and user interactions.

classes.name: NavigationCardsWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending WidgetSettingsComponent for managing navigation card widget settings, including filter configuration and user input handling.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables filter controls based on filterType value.

methods.name: fetchFilterItems
methods.description: Fetches and filters filter items based on search text.

methods.name: addFilterItem
methods.description: Adds a new filter item if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: onFilterItemRemoved
methods.description: Removes a filter item from the list.

methods.name: onFilterItemInputFocus
methods.description: Triggers input change event on focus.

methods.name: addFilterItemFromChipInput
methods.description: Adds filter item from chip input event.

methods.name: filterItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of filter item from autocomplete.

methods.name: clearFilterItemInput
methods.description: Clears and resets the filter input field.
